Package ru.nsu.krasnyanskii.pizzeria.view

Interface PizzeriaView

All Superinterfaces:
BakerView, CourierView, GeneratorView, LifecycleView
All Known Implementing Classes:
ConsolePizzeriaView
public interface PizzeriaView extends BakerView, CourierView, GeneratorView, LifecycleView
Composite view that aggregates all role-specific view interfaces.

Implementations of this interface satisfy every output channel of the pizzeria. Clients should depend on the narrowest role interface they need (BakerView, CourierView, GeneratorView, LifecycleView) rather than on this composite.
